57:766.name: Button
57:766.description:
Purpose: An interactive button for actions and navigation. The primary interactive element across the entire design system.


Variants (variant prop):
- Solid — filled background, used for primary actions
- Outline — transparent with border, used for secondary actions  
- Ghost — transparent pill circle with icon, used for soft CTAs
- Solid-Input — compact, used exclusively inside InputGroup


Sizes (size prop):
- sm — height: var(--btn-height-sm), font: var(--btn-font-sm)
- md — height: var(--btn-height-md), font: var(--btn-font-md)
- lg — height: var(--btn-height-lg), font: var(--btn-font-lg)
- xl — height: var(--btn-height-xl), font: var(--btn-font-xl)


States: Default, Hover, Active, Focus, Disabled


Token references:
- Background: var(--color-primary-500) → var(--color-primary-600) hover → var(--color-primary-700) active → var(--color-disabled-bg) disabled
- Border radius: var(--radius-pill) for Solid/Outline/Ghost, var(--radius-button) for Solid-Input
- Font weight: var(--font-weight-semibold)
- Icon gap: var(--space-2)
- Focus ring: box-shadow var(--color-focus-ring) with var(--color-surface) offset
- Transition: var(--transition-fast)


Agent instructions:
- Never hardcode any color, spacing, or size value
- Ghost variant always wraps icon in a circular pill — never plain icon
- Disabled state sets opacity via var(--color-disabled-bg), not via CSS opacity
- Accept: variant, size, disabled, leadingIcon, trailingIcon, label, onClick as props
